intro.text: The King of Teod and Sarene's loving father, who keeps her in Arelon after her betrothed is reported dead, because the alliance against Fjorden matters so much.
The King of Teod and Sarene's father, an honest, devout Korathi who has sworn to convert to Shu-Dereth if the gyorn Hrathen brings Sarene safely out of Elantris.

items.text: With the growing Fjordell Empire bearing down on Teod and Arelon alike, Eventeo judged the alliance important enough to keep Sarene in Arelon even after Raoden was reported dead.

Teod's troubles grew. Eventeo had to put down Mystery cultists, the Fjordell ambassador Ashgress walked out, Fjorden began closing its borders to Teo merchants, and Teod's ambassadors and spies started to vanish. He began to consider converting if Arelon fell.

Eventeo and King Iadon tried to hit back at Fjorden by binding their economies together; Iadon got the better of the deal. Eventeo's new spies told him of Iadon's death at once, and he and Sarene talked over their grim options.

With Sarene thrown into Elantris and Telrii, a friend of Hrathen's, about to take Arelon's throne, Eventeo told her he would come for her. She talked him out of it, but he put Teod's army on guard and warned that any ship entering Teo waters would be sunk.

Learning that Hrathen could cure Sarene, Eventeo contacted him and swore to convert to Shu-Dereth if she left Elantris safely, though the vow would put him under the command of even a lowly Derethi priest.

Dilaf told Eventeo he held Sarene and would kill her unless Teod gave in. When Dilaf came to Teod, Eventeo met him with a small honour guard, head bowed, but the monk meant to kill Sarene before his eyes; Hrathen struck Dilaf and sent the king off to defend his land. With Raoden, the Elantrians and Hrathen, Teod beat the invaders, and Eventeo found Sarene unharmed.

appearance.text: Eventeo is far smaller than his brother Kiin, both in muscle and in bulk, and is more portly than stocky. He wears green royal robes.

personality.text: Eventeo dotes on Sarene and puts her above tradition and contracts. With her he can be anxious, but also dryly funny, joking about her court schemes and about telling her mother she has killed Raoden.
Clever and politically astute, Eventeo is a hopeless businessman who relies on a fleet of accountants to run the royal finances.
Eventeo is honest and keeps his word. A devout follower of Shu-Korath, he is loyal enough to his people to give up his faith to save them.

items.text: Eventeo saw to it that Sarene's schooling included a thorough grounding in Shu-Dereth.
Unlike most Teo men, Eventeo married a clever woman. Their children are Sarene and her elder brother Teorn, who has given Eventeo grandchildren. His brother is Kiin.

Eventeo likes to talk politics with Sarene, respects her and knows how persuasive she is. Only to her will he admit when things are bad enough to frighten him. He has a special tone he uses to bring her round, which usually works. He never realized how she felt during her years in Teod, but their honest talks by seon let her open up to him.
